name: Pasqal
description: Pasqal builds neutral-atom quantum processors for solving real-world optimization and simulation problems. Founded by pioneers of cold atom physics including Alain Aspect (Nobel laureate), Pasqal delivers quantum computing solutions to enterprise clients in energy, automotive, and finance.
funding: Public (Nasdaq: PSQL, August 2026); USD 360M cash at IPO close

products.name: Neutral-Atom QPU
products.description: Programmable neutral-atom quantum processors with up to 1,000 qubits for optimization and simulation

products.name: Pasqal Cloud
products.description: Cloud access platform for running quantum workloads on Pasqal neutral-atom hardware

200+ employees delivering enterprise quantum solutions in energy, automotive, and finance

news.title: Pasqal and KACST launch multi-year quantum technology research program
news.excerpt: Pasqal announced multi-year quantum technology research program partnership

news.title: Aramco and Pasqal make history with Saudi Arabia's first quantum computer
news.excerpt: Aramco and Pasqal launch Saudi Arabia's first Quantum Computer and Middle East's first commercial Quantum Computing as a Service platform

news.title: Quantum scale-up Pasqal plans $2B SPAC listing, promises to 'remain French'
news.excerpt: Pasqal is merging with Bleichroeder Acquisition Corp II and will be listed on the Nasdaq. The merger values Pasqal at $2 billion, pre-money. Pasqal is accompanied by a separate $200 million private funding round.

news.title: Pasqal closes €340M financing in anticipation of public listing
news.excerpt: €170M private round plus €170M convertible financing from Parkway, Quanta Computer, LG Electronics and CMA CGM ahead of dual Nasdaq and Euronext listing.

news.title: Pasqal announces intention to go public in $2B SPAC deal
news.excerpt: Merger with Bleichroeder Acquisition Corp. II values Pasqal at about $2 billion and could bring $600M+ in total proceeds.

news.title: Pasqal Thoughts 2026 event marks quantum computing's shift from research to real-world deployment
news.excerpt: More than 150 participants from 10+ countries gathered in Paris to discuss industry use cases in finance, energy, and telecom, and Pasqal's path toward 1,000-qubit systems and HPC integration.

news.title: PINQ² becomes exclusive Canadian distributor of Pasqal neutral-atom quantum computers
news.excerpt: Partnership with PINQ² and Distriq gives Canadian enterprises and researchers access to Pasqal's neutral-atom platform for applications in energy, finance, aerospace, and materials science.

news.title: Pasqal selected as finalist in XPRIZE Quantum Applications competition
news.excerpt: Pasqal selected as one of five wildcard finalists from 62 submissions in the XPRIZE Quantum Applications competition backed by Google Quantum AI and GESDA, advancing to Phase II.

news.title: Aramco and Pasqal launch Saudi Arabia's first quantum computer and Middle East's first QCaaS platform
news.excerpt: Aramco inaugurated the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia's first quantum computer at its Dhahran data center, running Pasqal's 200-qubit neutral-atom QPU, with a commercial Quantum Computing as a Service platform for energy, logistics, and industrial optimization workloads.

news.title: Pasqal selected as Phase II wildcard finalist in USD 5M XPRIZE Quantum Applications competition
news.excerpt: Pasqal was chosen as one of five wildcard finalists in the XPRIZE Quantum Applications competition, selected from 62 Wildcard Registration submissions. As a finalist Pasqal advances toward the March 2027 grand prize stage worth USD 3 million.

news.title: Pasqal Demonstrates Logical Qubits Outperforming Physical Qubits for Solving Differential Equations
news.excerpt: Pasqal published research demonstrating, for the first time in neutral-atom quantum computing, that logical qubits outperform physical qubits when solving differential equations on real hardware, improving accuracy by over 50% on average and up to 10x on certain nonlinear problems. Hardware achieved 99.4% gate fidelity across aerospace, energy, pharmaceutical, and financial modeling applications.

news.title: Pasqal inaugurates SOL, Italy's first neutral-atom quantum computer, at CINECA in Bologna
news.excerpt: Pasqal's 140-qubit Orion QPU system, named SOL, was inaugurated at CINECA in Bologna, Italy—Europe's third Pasqal neutral-atom deployment. The system integrates with CINECA's Leonardo supercomputer for hybrid classical-quantum computing, co-financed by EuroHPC Joint Undertaking and Italy's Ministry of University and Research.

news.title: Pasqal inaugurates Italy's first neutral-atom quantum computer at CINECA
news.excerpt: A 140-qubit Pasqal Orion system named SOL was installed at CINECA in Bologna, Italy, integrated with the EuroHPC Leonardo supercomputer for hybrid quantum-classical workloads. This is Pasqal's third EuroHPC-linked system in Europe.

news.title: Crédit Agricole CIB and Pasqal advance strategic partnership to industrialize quantum computing for capital markets
news.excerpt: Crédit Agricole CIB and Pasqal signed a new phase of their partnership — started in 2019 — shifting from research exploration to industrializing quantum algorithms for capital markets, with first production use cases for capital reserve monitoring of risk-weighted assets targeted for 2028.

news.title: Pasqal and MegazoneCloud Sign MoU to Deploy Neutral-Atom Quantum Computing in South Korea
news.excerpt: Pasqal and MegazoneCloud (South Korea's largest AWS partner) signed an MoU to explore QPU integration into managed cloud services and pursue on-premises QPU deployments at Korean enterprise and HPC customers across finance, logistics, biotech, and manufacturing.

news.title: Pasqal Leads Launch of €50M Q-PLANET EU Pilot Line to Industrialize Neutral-Atom Quantum Chips
news.excerpt: Q-PLANET, coordinated by Pasqal and co-funded by the EU Chips Joint Undertaking, kicked off with 28 European partners across 11 member states. The six-year €50M Framework Partnership Agreement aims to advance neutral-atom chip components from TRL 4 to TRL 6.

news.title: Pasqal leads Q-PLANET, €50M EU pilot line to industrialize neutral-atom quantum chips
news.excerpt: Chips JU and Pasqal launched Q-PLANET, a €50M initiative coordinated by Pasqal with 28 European partners across 11 member states. The six-year framework aims to establish a pan-European fab for neutral atom quantum chips, targeting industrialization at scale by 2030.

news.title: Pasqal and Crédit Agricole CIB Advance Strategic Partnership for Quantum in Capital Markets
news.excerpt: Crédit Agricole CIB and Pasqal formalized an advanced strategic partnership to accelerate quantum computing deployment in capital markets, with initial production use cases targeted for 2028, focusing on risk analytics and portfolio optimization.

news.title: Pasqal receives SEC clearance for SPAC combination with Bleichroeder; shareholder vote set for August 25, 2026
news.excerpt: Pasqal's joint Form F-4 registration statement with Bleichroeder Acquisition Corp. II was declared effective by the SEC on August 5, 2026. Bleichroeder scheduled an extraordinary general meeting for August 25, 2026 for shareholders to vote on the proposed $2 billion business combination.

news.title: SEC declares Pasqal SPAC merger registration effective ahead of August 25 shareholder vote
news.excerpt: The SEC declared effective the joint Form F-4 Registration Statement for Pasqal's business combination with Bleichroeder Acquisition Corp. II (NASDAQ: BBCQ). Bleichroeder shareholders are scheduled to vote on August 25, 2026; upon closing, the combined company will trade on Nasdaq under ticker PSQL.

news.title: Pasqal demonstrates on-chip qubit control using photonic integrated circuit, trapping four rubidium atoms
news.excerpt: Pasqal, in collaboration with its subsidiary Aeponyx, demonstrated trapping four individual rubidium atoms using laser light generated by a silicon nitride photonic integrated circuit — replacing bulk optics with a chip-scale approach. The result supports Pasqal's roadmap to scale toward 10,000+ physical atoms.

news.title: Pasqal and Eleven Ventures Form Joint Venture for Quantum Computing in Saudi Arabia
news.excerpt: Pasqal and Eleven Ventures agreed to establish a commercial joint venture to deploy and commercialize Pasqal's neutral-atom quantum computing systems in Saudi Arabia and the wider region, with plans to deploy multiple quantum systems and develop local quantum talent.

news.title: Pasqal Completes Nasdaq Listing Under Ticker PSQL, Shares Nearly Double on Debut
news.excerpt: Pasqal completed its business combination with Bleichroeder Acquisition Corp. II on August 28, 2026, beginning trading on Nasdaq under tickers PSQL and PSQLW with approximately USD 360 million in cash at close. Shares rose 95.2% to USD 19.11 on the first day of trading.

news.title: Pasqal and True Nexus encode protein gelation structures on neutral-atom QPU in first quantum-biology milestone
news.excerpt: Pasqal and True Nexus announced the successful use of Pasqal's neutral-atom quantum computer to encode protein structures relevant to gelation — the process that determines food texture. The collaboration combines AI-driven protein analysis with neutral-atom quantum computing to map how protein structure determines functionality, targeting applications in food technology and biotechnology under Saudi Arabia's Vision 2030 initiative.
